summary: A minimal exact two-wall model and a matched local/infinity-memory pair refute every memoryless local-type-to-global-cut inference, but neither is source-reconstructed from a realizable UOM(4,8) parent; no actual D9 counterexample or universal coverage proof is present.

minimal_exact_countermodel.scope: fatal counterexample to the abstract implication from smooth cooriented graph walls, transverse multiwalls, consistent literals, and proper pairwise-incomparable regions to connected strict sign sectors
exact_component_decomposition: x<-1, 0<y<x^2-1, and zj>0 for all j
x>1, 0<y<x^2-1, and zj>0 for all j
minimal_exact_countermodel.separator_proof: Any path from the left witness to the right witness has x=0 somewhere; there q2=-1-y<0 because q1=y>0.
minimal_exact_countermodel.component_charts: On either x interval, (x,s,z) with s=y/(x^2-1) identifies the component with an interval times (0,1) times (0,infinity)^7.

local_certificates.local_link: all intersections are simple normal crossings; each full multiwall has the complete 2^9 orthant link

minimal_exact_countermodel.minimality: Within arrangements of globally connected graph walls with nonzero common pivot, dimension one gives intersections of oriented rays and cannot disconnect; one graph-wall side in dimension two is connected. Two walls in dimension two are therefore the smallest such core. Seven coordinate halfspaces lift it to the nine-region/nine-dimensional hostile model.
minimal_exact_countermodel.not_an_actual_d9_counterexample: No UOM(4,8) parent matrix/chirotope, nine extension signatures, residual determinant occurrence map, parent-unit orientation map, or complete parent-cell residence certificate is supplied.

canonical_model_replay.relation_to_minimal_model: The degree-two model removes two roots and one component while preserving the exact logical failure.

global_memory_pair.purpose: show that local smooth/transverse type counts and a common leading form at infinity do not encode global nesting

common_local_data.q2_wall: one connected smooth global graph over (x,z)
common_local_data.q1_q2_intersection: two disjoint smooth circles, everywhere transverse

different_global_behavior.disjoint_base: the connected exterior of the two disjoint closed unit disks centered at (-3,0) and (3,0)

global_memory_pair.nine_region_lift: Use q3=u1, q4=1-u1, and q5 through q9=u2 through u6 in R^9; the common auxiliary sector is (0,1) times (0,infinity)^5 and does not change component counts.
global_memory_pair.consequence: A finite grammar must retain component identities and the global attachment/nesting relation of wall strata. Type names, local circuit links, orientation multisets, recursive flags, and coarse infinity leading forms are insufficient.

exact_domain_gate.name: SOURCE_RECONSTRUCTIBLE_D9_INSTANCE
exact_domain_gate.statement: X must be one normalized realization cell of a realizable UOM(4,8) parent; every qj must be a primitive global residual determinant factor with all labeled occurrences and fixed-sign parent-unit transports; every Fi must be the actual feasibility locus of a named extension signature; parent residence, properness, and ordered noninclusions must be exact.
exact_domain_gate.effect: This is the least noncircular theorem-domain gate that rejects the abstract model: the required source reconstruction is absent.
exact_domain_gate.nonconsequence: Membership in the D9 source class does not itself prove component-faithful coverage or connectivity.

exact_structural_discriminator.name: GLOBAL_COMPONENT_FAITHFUL_SIGN_GEODESY
exact_structural_discriminator.statement: The complete compactified chamber/stratum incidence is covered, each chamber occurrence has a stable global component identity, and the factor-sign map is injective and isometric (equivalently for the sufficient route, any two generic points admit a path crossing each geometric factor at most once).
exact_structural_discriminator.effect: The minimal and canonical models fail immediately because distinct sector components have the identical all-positive factor-sign word. The nested/disjoint pair shows why component-faithful global attachment, not only local types or a leading infinity form, is load-bearing.

countermodel_rejection_hypotheses.weakest_direct_but_circular_separator: Assuming every realizable complete factor-sign cell is connected also rejects the model, but this simply assumes the target connectivity and is not an acceptable reduction lemma.

attack_matrix.evidence: The minimal model has only smooth connected graph walls and simple normal crossings but its all-positive sector has two components; the nested/disjoint pair has matching local inventories and leading form but different component counts.

The two full multiwall occurrences in the minimal model have standard orthant links, while both adjacent all-positive chamber germs carry one factor-sign word yet belong to different global components. Stable occurrence and attachment identities are required.

The abstract model has no source-derived parent compactification. Moreover the nested/disjoint pair shares its degree-four leading form, so a coarse infinity sign is insufficient; complete attachment incidence is required.

DIAG9_ACTIVE_SECTOR_THEOREM transports every occurrence through sign(c_E*u_E) and declares opposite transported active orientations empty. Any schema that stores only a factor ID or raw occurrence sign remains unsound.

The minimal nine-region model has 72 exact ordered noninclusion witnesses. For actual D9, a sampled network cannot prove global inclusion or universal support; exact global labels or ordered witnesses are required.
The exact left and right feasible witnesses have the identical sign word (+,+,+,+,+,+,+,+,+) but lie in different components.
The two selected supports have exact opposite parent initial forms with positive Gordan weights; the ordinary common-radial strict link is empty and weighted recursive facets remain open.
q=d*i-e has negative, zero, and positive exact lifts while bracket 1237 stays zero; this is a recursive-facet wall, not a strict-open-parent or global separator.

The parent-860 16-chord repair connects all support intersections on its exact 24-chamber embedded network, but its source explicitly disclaims chamber coverage, component interception, and global D9 promotion.
No exact realizable parent, proper incomparable nine-family, two feasible witnesses, and complete compactified separator certificate were found or supplied.

coverage.included: Exact abstract polynomial models; exact smoothness, pivot, transversality, properness/incomparability, component, sign-word, and global-memory checks; source-scope replay of the S12,37, factor-8552, and parent-860 network canaries.
coverage.excluded: No exhaustive search of 2,604 parents or admissible nine-families; no complete D9 compactified roadmap; no producer artifact review; no claim that the abstract polynomials are residual determinants.
coverage.first_unresolved_discriminator: Construct, for one actual source-reconstructible D9 family, the complete compactified active-sector chamber/stratum incidence with stable global component IDs and true-infinity attachments, then decide whether two chambers with the same complete active-factor sign word occur in distinct components. A same-word pair is fatal to sign-geodesy; its absence under complete coverage is the first evidence capable of rejecting the abstract mechanism noncircularly.
